title: George Lewis band at El Morocco and trumpeters Talbert and Kid Howard
summary: Steinau recalls the El Morocco engagement from about early 1950 and the trumpet changes after Elmer Talbert's illness, with Allen on the Kid Howard period and the air-conditioned stage.
